passage:
The River Bus is the easiest way to travel around Lake City. It stops at six places: North Museum, Old Bridge, Fish Market, Green Island, City Park, and South Station.
A one-day pass costs $80 for adults and $40 for children under twelve. With the pass, you can ride the River Bus as many times as you want on the same day. Tickets for one ride cost $25, so the pass is best for visitors who plan to take four or more rides.
The first boat leaves South Station at 8:30 a.m. The last boat leaves Green Island at 6:00 p.m. Boats come every thirty minutes, but they may stop running during heavy rain.
Food is not allowed on the boat. Drinks with covers are OK. Bikes can be taken on the boat before 10:00 a.m. and after 4:00 p.m.
